title: RNA-seq of ROCK2 live-sorted cells
description: ROCK2 is a protein shown to be involved in radiation resistance. This study performed live sorting of SiHa cells (a cervical cancer cell line) on the basis of ROCK2 expression. R2High are cells with increased ROCK2 expression and R2Low are cells with decreased ROCK2 expression.

samples.title: Sample 1
samples.description: Protocols: Blood was collected in EDTA vacutainers, buffy coat was collected and RBC lysis was performed. The RNA was isolated by the TRIzol method as described by the manufaacturer. Quantification was performed using the Qubit Fluorometer. The NEBNext Ultra Directional RNA Library Prep kit (E7420L) was utilized for RNA extraction and RNA-seq library preparation.

runs.experiment_title: Illumina HiSeq 1000 sequencing: RNA-seq of ROCK2 live-sorted cells
